revision_summary: Two minor wrong_ts quote citations need correcting: (1) script_coverage[2] address_homeowner customer_quote 'we've only been renting it...' is actually at 00:51 (start) through 00:58, not 00:33 — 00:33 is the rep stating the street address. (2) script_coverage[4] roof customer_quote 'But the trees really only...' is actually at 01:57-02:06, not 01:09 — 01:09 is the rep's tree question. Fix both timestamps in script_coverage. Additionally, four schema_reference citations in cherry_pick_moments are misapplied and should be corrected on rerun: cherry_pick_moments[0] cites qualifiers.credit_qualifier for a roof/shading DQ (should reference verify.roof_type_age or dq_rules.roof_too_old_no_replacement instead); cherry_pick_moments[1] and [3] cite coaching_philosophy.objection_inversion for moments that are not cost/time/interest objection flips but rather DQ-process/lead-handling gaps (objection_inversion's trigger_phrases are specifically about affordability/time/interest objections, not roof DQ decisions — use a general DQ-handling framing instead); cherry_pick_moments[2] cites coaching_philosophy.curiosity_over_features for a rep failing to follow up on a customer's factual correction, which is not what that schema section addresses (it concerns rep over-explaining features, not failing to probe customer info) — reclassify under knowledge_gap_handling or a general re-engagement gap. Also tighten trajectory_verdict.outcome_dispute: don't claim the v1 tag is 'unknown/unclear' and then argue against a specific alternative reading in the same breath — state the observed-outcome reasoning on its own terms (premature DQ + unanchored callback) without speculating on what v1 actually tagged. Finally, consider elevating the ownership ambiguity ('renting' vs 'owned for a long time') currently buried in cherry_pick_moments[4] — this touches a HARD qualifier (verify.address_homeowner_confirmed / not_homeowner dq) and deserves more prominence given it was never resolved before the call ended.
